entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-07-01
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Make `dotnet project convert app.cs` interactive by default #49624
    10.0.1xx
  • Ctrl+C on a `dnx`-invoked tool shows an unescapable Windows Batch termination dialog #49623
  • .Net SDK 8.0.411 published self contained app has exit code -2147450749 when running from UNC path #49620
  • Does dotnet run Program.cs support using or importing other .cs files? #49618
  • Multi-RID packages should strip all package types except `DotnetToolRidPackage` from the 'inner' packages #49615
    10.0.1xx
  • Central package management is not working for multi-targeted projects #49614
  • Workload resolver too slow #49609

Closed

  • .NET SDK doesn't handle all invalid characters in the root namespace #49327
  • NETSDK1138 not generated for .NET 6 #46640
    10.0.1xx
  • The PackAddsCorrectFilesForProjectsWithOutputNameSpecified test fails due to assembly name not being overridden #47246

PullRequests

Created

  • [WIP] [do not review] enable containerd tests #49617
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Strip all package types from inner multi-rid tool packages so they don't appear on search-based experiences #49616
  • [automated] Update man pages #49612
  • References #49611
    Area-AspNetCore

Merged

  • Fix path #49608
  • Capstone is a native 3rd party component and shouldn't be scanned #49532
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Fix RootNamespace handling for dashes and starting digits in project names #49328
  • Add .NET 6.0 to End-of-Life frameworks list to generate NETSDK1138 warnings #49533
  • The pull request label check wasn't getting run when a draft PR was published #49546
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Fix test issue 47246: Adding the dotnet pack parameters #49613
  • Support `dotnet clean file.cs` #49511
    Area-run-file
  • Ensure binlogs from file-based apps have evaluation data #49588
    Area-run-file
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #49610
    Area-CodeFlow

Updated

  • Use ProjectGraph for DTB #49589
    Area-Watch
  • Improve MSBuild argument parsing and tracking, and use that to set RestoreProperties that optimize Restore for large projects #49526
    Area-CLI
  • Skip MSBuild and call only CSC for simple file-based apps #49528
    Area-run-file, 10.0.1xx
  • Include some default items in file-based apps #49584
    Area-run-file
  • Fix overriding HelpName in Parser.cs, set it explicitly instead #49423
  • Clean up containers packaging, leaning into NuGet's expected patterns #49518
    Area-Containers
  • Make it so the artifacts folders register files for cleanup #49595
  • Consume shared components from external URI in non-1xx feature band #49607
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Adjust `IsTestProject` hacks to not include MTP #49085
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0.3xx' => 'main' #49389
